import MDAnalysis as mda
from MDAnalysis.analysis.msd import EinsteinMSD
import numpy as np

# Load the trajectory
def analyze_msd(traj_file):
    u = mda.Universe(traj_file, format='LAMMPSDUMP')
    
    # Select all atoms
    all_atoms = u.select_atoms('all')
    
    # Compute MSD
    msd = EinsteinMSD(all_atoms, msd_type='xyz', fft=True)
    msd.run()
    
    # Extract MSD values and time
    msd_values = msd.results.msd
    time = msd.results.times
    
    # Find the melting point (first sudden jump in MSD after 500 ps)
    melting_point_index = np.argmax(np.diff(msd_values[500:])) + 500
    
    # Calculate diffusion constant after melting point
    diffusion_constant = np.mean(np.diff(msd_values[melting_point_index:]) / np.diff(time[melting_point_index:])) / 6
    
    return diffusion_constant

if __name__ == '__main__':
    import sys
    traj_file = sys.argv[1]
    diffusion_constant = analyze_msd(traj_file)
    print(f"{diffusion_constant:.2e}")
